mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost structure for AI SEO services for contractors?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of AI SEO services for remodeling contractors varies based on the scope of work, the specific AI tools utilized, and the level of customization required. Factors influencing pricing include keyword research depth, content optimization needs, competitor analysis, and ongoing performance monitoring. Some agencies offer tiered packages, while others provide custom quotes. It's common to see pricing structured as monthly retainers, reflecting the continuous nature of SEO work.
acceptedAnswer.description: The cost of AI SEO services for contractors varies by scope, tools, and customization, often structured as monthly retainers based on services like keyword research and content optimization.
